response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and AWS — aligning with core requirements — but his seniority far exceeds the entry-level role, and his resume suggests overqualification and potential misalignment with team structure or salary expectations; additionally, his German language skill is basic despite high on-site requirements in Berlin.
strengths: Strong TypeScript and React experience across multiple production systems
Proven fullstack ownership from API to UI with real-world scalability examples
Active open-source contributions and deep understanding of software architecture
concerns: Significantly overqualified for entry-level role; risk of attrition or misfit
Basic German proficiency may hinder on-site collaboration in Berlin
Extensive history in senior/staff roles suggests potential misalignment with IC expectations
